name: Southend-on-Sea
appliesTo: These dates are for community schools in the city of Southend-on-Sea, namely: Chalkwell Hall Infant, Earls Hall Primary, Fairways Primary, Leigh North Street, West Leigh Infants.
academyNote: Most schools in the city follow the dates however, term dates for foundation and voluntary-aided schools and academies may be different. Check with your child's school for their term dates.

localFacts.fact: Southend-on-Sea City Council sets term dates for just five community schools: Chalkwell Hall Infant, Earls Hall Primary, Fairways Primary, Leigh North Street and West Leigh Infants.
Most schools in the city follow the council's dates, although foundation, voluntary aided schools and academies can set their own.
Schools allocate five non-pupil days out of the school days shown, or the equivalent in disaggregated twilight sessions.
The 2027-28 October half term is listed as Friday 22 October to Friday 29 October 2027, so it starts on a Friday.
The 2027-28 May half term is listed as 30 May to 2 June 2028, after the spring bank holiday on Monday 29 May.
The council strongly advises parents to check with their child's school before making any holiday or other commitments.

2026-27.insetNote: In addition, schools allocate five non-pupil days out of the school days indicated, or the equivalent in disaggregated twilight sessions.
2026-27.notes: The council lists term start and end dates and half terms; Christmas and Easter breaks are the gaps between terms.

2027-28.insetNote: Schools allocate five non-pupil days out of the school days indicated, or the equivalent in twilight sessions.
2027-28.notes: October half term listed as 22 to 29 October 2027 (starting on a Friday), so the first half of autumn term ends Thursday 21 October. May half term listed as 30 May to 2 June 2028, after the spring bank holiday on Monday 29 May.
